title: Vitest configuration file generator
description: Generate a vitest.config.ts file for a project.

project.description: The name of the project in which to generate a vitest config.
project.x-prompt: To which project would you like to add a Vitest configuration file?

coveragePath.description: Specify a path to write coverage reports, relative to the workspace root.

globals.description: Allow vitest to inject jest-like API's into the testing environment.

includeTest.description: Include configuration for Vitest in the generated file.

inSourceTests.description: Include setup for writing tests directly in source code files, rather than creating separate *.spec files.

skipTsconfigs.description: Skip updating the project's tsconfig.json files.

testEnvironment.description: The testing environment for the project.

testReportPath.description: Specify a path to write unit test reports, relative to the workspace root.

tsconfigName.description: Set the filename to use for the build tsconfig referenced by the test tsconfig.
